text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Pilot BSP; frozen fits scored by mean absolute error in points of effective capacity over the year after each cut, averaged over its MW Primaries. Top: summed extra error from 200 injected errors in the tuning year. Bottom: clean error minus weight 0's. Solid: first run. Dashed: re-run after the BSP-row scale was corrected. Dotted line: the 0.023-point limit.'
text.tspan: Pilot BSP; frozen fits scored by mean absolute error in points of effective capacity over the year
after each cut, averaged over its MW Primaries. Top: summed extra error from 200 injected errors in
the tuning year. Bottom: clean error minus weight 0's. Solid: first run. Dashed: re-run after the
BSP-row scale was corrected. Dotted line: the 0.023-point limit.
